//: The published module-surface emit (dist/*.js + .d.ts), bundler-mode: engine's supported consumers are Workers embedders who build through wrangler or esbuild, so relative specifiers stay extensionless and the dev-model Text module stays importable. Include is overridden to src only — the base config includes test/**, and an emitted test file under rootDir: src is a TS6059 error. The daemon tree keeps its own nodenext emit (tsconfig.daemon.json); scripts/build.mjs runs both and asserts the one shared output file (dist/credential-guard.js) is identical across them. No source maps: files is ["dist"], and a map naming a file the tarball does not contain is worse than no map.
